title: Async Validation & the Test Staging Lane
summary: A design proposal: stop running the full test suite per card and per retry. Batch validation on a test-integration branch fed by a staging lane, scope tests deterministically, and cache gate results per SHA. Rests on the pipeline-time-economy evidence.
statusReason: AGT-2155 and AGT-2293 are archived, and the staging and gate design is implemented in the current pipeline.
